text: I am a UC Berkeley graduate raised by a hard-working immigrant family. I dedicated over 20 years of service to the people of Bell Gardens. From my first job as a teenage lifeguard at Ford Park Pool to serving on the City Council, I've always believed government is meant to improve the lives of working families.
As your Councilmember and former Mayor, I've worked to build a Bell Gardens that invests in people, delivering results you can see and feel every day:

- Built a new Dreamers Aquatics Center ($16 million in grants)
- Created a Community Family Service Center providing resources for mental health, parenting, domestic violence support, immigration, and senior services
- Approved a Rent Stabilization Ordinance
- Diversified and increased revenue sources
- Strengthen our local water supply and made environmental investments
- Created fairer elections through term limits and lowered campaign contribution limits
- Created better programs, community groups, art, culture and recreation opportunities

My goal is to continue fighting for safe neighborhoods, quality of life issues, small businesses, and opportunities for all families. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue to make a difference together.

text: Two years ago, you entrusted me with the responsibility of serving Bell Gardens. Since then, we have made meaningful progress together.

We strengthened neighborhood partnerships, and resources that help protect our families. We advanced housing and economic development opportunities while supporting local businesses and planning responsibly for our city's future. We also delivered important investments in parks, recreation, and community facilities, creating spaces where residents of every generation can gather, grow, and thrive.
These achievements did not come without obstacles. The next four years will be critical, and Bell Gardens needs leadership that will protect our progress and keep moving us forward.
At the heart of every priority the goal is to improve the quality of life for every Bell Gardens resident.
We have built strong momentum, and more is yet to come. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue flourishing a safer, stronger, and more prosperous Bell Gardens!
Visit: migueldelarosa.org

text: I am Samuel Perez, a lifelong Bell Gardens resident who is proud to have attended our local schools. I earned a bachelor's degree in Accounting from California State University, Los Angeles, College of Business and Economics, after completing a Certificate in Banking and Money.

I currently serve as Vice Chair of the Bell Gardens Traffic and Safety Commission, working to improve public safety and the quality of life in our community. Professionally, I work for the Los Angeles County Office of Education supporting payroll systems for school districts throughout Los Angeles County. My experience also includes accounting and finance with the City of Pico Rivera, serving as an office clerk for the City of Bell Gardens, and administrative work with Long Beach Unified School District.
As a Christian minister, I am committed to serving others with integrity, compassion, and accountability.

If elected to the Bell Gardens City Council, I will work to strengthen public safety, promote transparent and accountable government, support responsible fiscal management, and encourage thoughtful economic growth while preserving the values that make Bell Gardens a great place to live, work, and raise a family.

text: Age: 42
Occupation: Administrator
Bell Gardens is the community that raised me, shaped my values, and inspired my commitment to public service. Serving you on the City Council has been one of the greatest honors of my life.

Since being elected in 2022, I have worked to bring responsive, transparent, and community-centered leadership to City Hall. I have advocated for safer neighborhoods, responsible use of taxpayer dollars, improved streets and public spaces, strong programs for youth and seniors, and opportunities that bring families together and strengthen community pride.
As an educator, school administrator, and Doctor of Educational Leadership, I have dedicated my career to empowering others and creating pathways to success. I
bring that same heart, discipline, and accountability to every decision I make as your councilwoman.

Together, we have made meaningful progress, but our work is not finished. I will continue fighting for public safety, financial stability, economic growth, quality parks and services, and a city government that listens to residents and puts their needs first.

I am proud of how far Bell Gardens has come and hopeful about where we are going. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue building a safer, stronger, and more prosperous Bell Gardens together.

text: As a Bell Gardens resident and a father of three, I have felt inspired to serve my community and its people. I, Jorge O. Verdin, not only love the City of Bell Gardens, but I truly care about each and every one of our residents.

I am constantly thinking about how I can make a positive impact on our community. Some of my earliest memories are of walking to Garfield Elementary School, picking up pinecones along the way, and learning the importance of taking pride in the place I call home. Those early experiences helped shape my commitment to serving others.

I have always believed in supporting our local businesses and strengthening the community that has given so much to my family. It would be an incredible honor to serve on the Bell Gardens City Council with integrity, honesty, and dedication. My goal is to listen to our residents, represent them faithfully, and work together to build an even stronger, safer, and more united Bell Gardens for future generations.
